notes.title: Update: "Red world"
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game has a new character, new levels and the ability to switch gravity.
[*] Added levels with low gravity, the character can shrink and go through very small passages.
[*] New dangerous levels with low gravity in the red world.
[/list]
